display_long_description:
# Turn Your Home Into an Automated Factory

Start with a handful of machines and grow them into a massive industrial empire that fills your room.

🪨 Mine and transport resources

🏭 Build production chains to create increasingly valuable products

🤖 Record loops with drones and industrial robots to create an automated workforce

📈 Expand, optimize, and scale your factory

🏠 Play in mixed reality and transform your real room into an industrial playground

[media]

Every conveyor belt, machine, and worker you create brings your factory one step closer to total automation.

Sell products to earn money and research new materials, unlocking more advanced facilities and production lines. Grow from simple resource extraction to a sprawling automated operation capable of constructing an entire server tower, one floor at a time.

[media]

# Just one. More. Loop.
Build on top of furniture, place virtual tables, or get comfy and sit down on your floor to play in this physics playground.

[media]

# Record loops - automate your factory

**Features**

🎯 2h+ campaign mode

♾️ Freeplay and infinite sandbox mode

🏭18 facilities (and growing)

⏺️ 3 recordable items (drones and industrial robots)

💾 Extensive save system with restore tools if your playspace has been removed or changed.

↔️ Scaling options to play in all kind of rooms

🎮 Physics-driven gameplay - infinite solutions - very fun!

**Build with 💜 by Jonas Sandstedt**
[media]
